A city-sized protective ward flaring to blazing life, an immense dome of golden runes igniting across every rooftop and wall, the entire metropolis sealed in shimmering magical light against the encroaching darkness.
A storm conjured into a sky-filling vortex, clouds corkscrewing down toward a churning eye of lightning and hail, the winds shrieking loud enough to crack fortress walls across the valley below.
A phoenix summoned in a catastrophic eruption of white and crimson flame, wings spanning the width of a mountain, every feather a roaring torch, the air scorched clean for miles around.

Time fracturing outward in a spreading crystalline freeze, seconds shattering like glass across the battlefield, soldiers and flames and falling arrows suspended mid-motion inside iridescent shards of stopped eternity.
A leyline eruption splitting the ground in a jagged mile-long fissure, raw magical energy fountaining upward in blinding columns of gold and white, the earth groaning and heaving on both sides.

A colossal rune-array igniting across an entire mountain face, each carved symbol blazing sequential crimson, a chain-reaction of power building to a deafening resonant pulse that shakes the clouds apart above.
A soul torn screaming from its vessel by an iron-gauntleted sorcerer, the translucent form stretched and howling as it is drawn upward into a swirling black vortex, the emptied body crumbling to ash.

An ancient sea-god forced through a oceanic summoning-rift, colossal tentacles breaching the harbor surface, water displaced in continent-wide waves, the sky darkening with ink-cloud as the harbour city is engulfed in shadow.

A dragonlord binding spell cast across the sky, enormous chains of molten rune-light wrapping a roaring elder dragon mid-flight, the creature thrashing against crackling golden links as the caster screams the final word.

An infernal gate wrenched open at a mountain's base, sulfurous hellfire pouring outward in rivers, armored demon legions marching forth in lockstep through the billowing black smoke and cascading ember-fall.

A grand illusion of annihilation unleashed upon an army, a false apocalypse of screaming false comets and thundering phantom voices so overwhelming that ten-thousand soldiers break and flee in absolute mindless terror.

A tidal wave conjured inland, a wall of magically-compelled ocean rising over a forest, the sorcerer's staff raised as the impossible green water tower crests a hundred feet and begins its obliterating descent.

A resurrection ritual gone catastrophically wrong, the target reborn as a colossal undead titan, burial shrouds burning away as a body the size of a tower lurches upright, the ritual circle obliterated beneath one footfall.

A plague-curse spread by a single spoken syllable, black blossoms of corruption blooming across stone and flesh simultaneously, the spreading wave of necrotic magic visible from the hills as a rolling shadow eating the land.

An elemental lord of earth called into being by a shaman's drumbeat, a mountain reassembling itself into a walking colossus of rock and root, boulders orbiting its shoulders as it turns with slow seismic purpose.

A memory-erase cast upon an entire kingdom, a shimmering silver fog rolling from horizon to horizon, every living person within standing motionless as decades of recollection are drawn upward in luminous threads and extinguished.

A dimensional anchor shattered by a rogue mage, reality peeling back like burned parchment, the underlying chaotic void visible through a spreading tear, gravity reversing and reversing again in the unraveling zone around it.

A heavenly intercession spell striking down like divine wrath, a column of sacred white fire descending from parted clouds onto a corrupted citadel, the stone singing before it simply ceases to exist in blinding silence.
